name: Dark Castle
description: Falz boss, Lassic's ethereal castle remains.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: He left for Makara six hours after the seal in the inner chamber broke. Took two team members and a comm channel. The team came back. He didn't.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: We're not assuming anything yet. He could be alive. He could have lost his bearings inside the structure that's now open. He could have followed something in.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: The ruins are still there. So is whatever was sealed. If he went deeper, he went into something we don't have a name for.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: Find him. Bring him back if you can.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: And if you can't... bring back the truth.
